Description: Implement Amazon Cognito for centralized identity management with fine-grained access controls
Use AWS WAF rate-based rules to limit requests per IP address within specific timeframes
Implement usage-based pricing model and API Gateway usage plans with request quotas
Leverage AWS CloudTrail and CloudWatch to detect unusual API usage patterns and set up alerts
Configure AWS WAF CAPTCHA and Challenge actions for suspicious request patterns
Use AWS CloudWatch anomaly detection to identify unusual behavior in API metrics
Implement logical fallacy detection using LangChain to filter malicious queries
Enable Amazon Bedrock Guardrails for content filtering and responsible AI policy enforcement
Use AWS KMS envelope encryption for data at rest and in transit to protect model responses
Implement comprehensive logging with Amazon Bedrock model invocation logging and CloudWatch integration
